description: This file defines a Java interface 'LogNode' for a logging system, establishing a contract for classes that output logs to one or more targets and enabling chaining or filtering of log data.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log entries and potentially chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception. Implementations will define how and where the log is output.
